##Loading ARAPORT11--------------------------------------------------------

Newest version of ARAPORT11 can be found in: https://www.arabidopsis.org/download/list?dir=Proteins%2FAraport11_protein_lists

```{r load_FASTA}
fasta_file <- "/.../Araport11_pep_20250411.fasta"
```

##Reading FASTA header-----------------------------------------------------

```{r reading_header}
fasta_lines <- readLines(fasta_file, warn = FALSE)
headers <- fasta_lines[startsWith(fasta_lines, ">")]
```

##Extract transcript id----------------------------------------------------

```{r extract_id}
transcript_id <- regmatches(
  headers,
  regexpr("AT[1-5MC]G[0-9]{5}(\\.[0-9]+)?", headers)
)
```

##Clean up non-extract header----------------------------------------------

```{r clean_up}
keep <- nzchar(transcript_id)
headers <- headers[keep]
transcript_id <- transcript_id[keep]

if (length(transcript_id) == 0) {
  stop("No TAIR IDs were extracted from the FASTA headers. Please check the file and header format.")
}
```

##Extract Araport11 Entries with UniProt Matches---------------------------

``` {r extract_entry}
tair_id <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", transcript_id)

header_table <- data.frame(
  fasta_header = headers,
  transcript_id = transcript_id,
  tair_id = tair_id,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

##Save list----------------------------------------------------------------

```{r save_list}
writetable(header_table, "/.../Araport11_TAIR_headers.txt")

ids <- unique(tair_id)
writeLines(ids, "/.../Araport11_TAIR_IDs.txt")
```
We recommend pasting the extracted AGIs into UniProt’s ID Mapping tool rather than retrieving UniProtKB entries in R.
